verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no balance holds, escrow-like retention of seller funds, or release on a schedule or trigger. Updating a merchant's deposit frequency (docs-7) only sets a recurring payout cadence. It is an adjacent control, not a hold-until-delivery or dispute-window mechanism. Amount splits cover a different funds-routing capability.

support.subject: As a developer, funds can wait — hold seller funds in a balance until delivery or dispute windows pass, release on my schedule or trigger, with the escrow-like mechanics and their limits documented
